div.head: Grið 9
div.ab: 7 on Suðengla lage griðlagu þus stent, ðæt, gif hwa gefeohteð on cyrican oððon on cynges huse, þonne sy forworht eal þæt he age, 7 sy on cynges dome, hwæðer he lif age þe nage.
And on Suðengla lage, griðlagu þus stent: ðæt, gif hwa gefeohteð on cyrican oððon on cynges huse, þonne sy forworht eal þæt he age, and sy on cynges dome, hwæðer he lif age þe nage.

Und im Recht der Südengländer gilt das Sonderfriedensrecht so: dass, wenn einer ficht in einer Kirche oder im Hause des Königs, dann sei verwirkt alles was er besitzt, und es stehe in des Königs Entscheidung, ob er sein Leben behalte oder verliere.

And in the law of the southern English the law of special peace stands thus: that if anyone fights in a church or in the king's house, then all that he owns is forfeit, and it rests with the king's judgment whether he keeps his life or not.

And according to southern English law, the law of sanctuary stands thus: if anyone fights in church or in the king’s house, then he is to forfeit all that he owns, and it is the king’s judgment whether he lives or dies.
